Name: Clint Portrait Fix-up
Author: jerryriganims
Description:
[center][size=4]This mod was created to satisfy that little itch everybody has over clint's design, but still keep his main appearance and in-game style.[/size][/center]
[center][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51393/51393-1787920525-160704605.gif[/img]
[/size]
[left][size=3]Completely honestly, Clint is made ugly, and while i respect that, I couldn't find any portrait mod anywhere that kept his original loser fat boy charm. I kept it as close to the OG as possible, what bothered me about the Clint portrait mods on nexus is they never feel like clint, either they've turned him skinny, paler and conventionally attractive, or there's too much happening design wise and it completely throws off the idea of Clint. So, i quit my whining and actually made a mod that does Clint [/size][i][size=3]just[/size][/i][size=3] enough justice to bump him up from eye sore to eye candy.[/size]

[size=3]This mod requires Content patcher to work, and is pretty bare bones so it's not compatible with other portrait mods unless disabled.[/size]

[size=4]For Compatibility with [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18345][size=4]Clint Reforged[/size][/url][size=4]:[/size]
[size=3]You will need to have the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic mod config menu[/size][/url][size=3] mod, open up the config options for Clint Reforged and change portraits to vanilla.[/size]

[size=4]Compatibility with Seasonal Cute characters and other sprite altering mods:[/size]
[size=3]no worky, have to turn it off for Clint fix-up mod to run[/size]

[size=4]How to download:[/size]
[size=3]Download the .ZIP, extract the file into your mods folder and run with SMAPI.[/size][/left]
[/center]
